summary: ITER144 P0 Tenant Foundation + Wildcard Tenant Runtime + Email Identity Runtime + Runtime Branding Continuity + Runtime Context Inspector — backend + frontend verified end-to-end. 48/48 aggregate pytest pass (17 ITER144 + 31 ITER143). Live preview URL backend probes confirm runtime/email_identity blocks, email_identity source switch (legacy→tenant_runtime→legacy after clear), and root-only runtime-inspector with proper 403 for tenant_admin and ?tenant_id support. Frontend: login as ROOT, AdminShell sidebar shows 13 NAV entries (incl. audit/advisors/modules/runtime_inspector), /admin/runtime-inspector renders 24 runtime-stat-* rows, refresh button operational; the three other newly restored admin routes mount the shell without crash.

issues: React console warning: 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' (setState-in-render) observed during admin page transitions — not blocking but should be cleaned up to avoid future reconciliation bugs.
Several 404 / 403 console errors during initial bootstrap on /dashboard and /admin routes (likely tenant-config secondary calls or missing static assets). Functionality unaffected but noisy.

action_items: Trace and fix the 'setState during render' React warning seen on /admin pages (likely a provider mutating state during a child render).
Investigate intermittent 404/403 calls during /dashboard and /admin boot to silence noise (Network tab during initial paint).

Frontend NAV array (13 entries) all data-testid annotated and routed; routes mount without runtime error.
